Findings are therefore anchored to the figure path with line null. This was already recorded as a non-blocking finding by the code review of the same run, so it is not repeated here.

findings.summary: Right panel: a read that is -Infinity cannot be placed on a log axis, so the sixteen perturbed lanes are drawn as X markers on a dotted row at exactly 1e0, coinciding with a real y-axis tick. A reader scanning the two rows sees 'perturbed about 1.0' against 'unperturbed about 3e-2', i.e. a thirty-fold larger residual, where the measured value is minus infinity. The annotation '-Infinity at the first read' and the caption's 'marked at the top of the panel' do disclose the substitution, so the panel is not misleading to a careful reader; the placement at a labelled tick is still a representation a glance can invert. Offset the sentinel row from the tick or break the axis to remove the ambiguity.

The two explanatory grey annotations ('three revisions coincide within 7e-4 at every step' and 'convergence gate 1e-10') render in #929292, about 3.1:1 against the white background, while the blue and near-black annotation text clears 6.9:1. Both grey lines carry information a reader needs (the coincidence tolerance and the gate the solve misses by seven orders), so the weakest-contrast text is the load-bearing text.

Left panel: the terminal plateau at 3.87e-3 is drawn strictly flat from step 6 to step 60, so a reader of the figure alone concludes the iteration holds a floor. The record states that the last fifty-four updates move the residual upward by 0.3%, and at a ten-decade log scale that rise cannot be shown; the figure therefore supports 'stalled' but not 'rising'. A reader who reads only the picture will not see the distinction the record relies on.

The figure's alternative text on this line says the residual 'falls to 3.86e-3', while the rendered label reads 'terminal 3.87e-3' and the record's own terminal value is 3.868493624452e-3, which rounds to 3.87e-3. The alt text has been truncated rather than rounded, giving a second, slightly smaller terminal figure in the same record.

review_text:
RUBRIC legibility: answered — both panels readable at a glance; decade log axes with clean 10^n ticks and no offset multiplier; both key features (step-6 refactor, terminal plateau) labelled beside themselves.
RUBRIC data_ink: answered — lines and markers only, frameless legend, direct labels; no fills or gradients.
RUBRIC decoration: answered — no gridlines, no background fill, top and right spines removed.
RUBRIC contrast: answered with a defect — blue 6.9:1 and near-black 19.7:1 clear, but the two grey annotations at #929292 measure about 3.1:1 on white (non-blocking).
RUBRIC table_form: answered — two plotted relationships, neither tabular.
RUBRIC label_collision: answered — no clipping, no overlap between labels or with data; the right panel's annotation clears the marker row by about 5 px.
FINDING figure non-blocking: -Infinity sentinels sit at exactly the 1e0 tick, which a glance can read as a residual of 1.0.
FINDING figure non-blocking: grey annotation text renders at about 3.1:1 contrast, and it carries the tolerance and the gate.
FINDING figure non-blocking: the left plateau is drawn strictly flat, so the record's 0.3% rise over the last fifty-four updates is not visible in the figure.
FINDING slice-profile-at-main.html:42 non-blocking: alt text reads 3.86e-3 where the label and the measured value give 3.87e-3.
No blocking finding: no clipped or overlapping label, no unreadable text, and no panel that with the data it chooses to show fails to show it.

rubric_items.contrast: Near-black and blue text clear their background (blue #1f5d92 measures about 6.9:1 on white, near-black 19.7:1), but the two grey annotation lines 'three revisions coincide within 7e-4 at every step' and 'convergence gate 1e-10' render at #929292, about 3.1:1 against white. That is legible but below the 4.5:1 an ordinary body-size text label needs; recorded below as a non-blocking finding.
rubric_items.data_ink: The data carry the weight. Three coincident residual traces and one convergence-gate reference line in the left panel, sixteen lane reads in each of two rows in the right panel, with frameless legends and direct labels; no fills, no gradients, no shaded bands.
rubric_items.decoration: No gridlines, no background fill, no decorative styling. Top and right spines are removed on both panels and the remaining spines render at the base style's 1.2 pt.
rubric_items.label_collision: No label is clipped, no label overlaps another, and no label sits on the data. The left panel's three annotations and its frameless legend all sit in clear white space; the right panel's two-line 'perturbed' block clears the marker row by about 5 px and the 'unperturbed' direct label sits above its line. Axis labels are fully within the canvas on all four sides.
rubric_items.legibility: Readable at a glance. Two panels, 1399x720 px, axis labels 16 pt and tick/direct labels 14 pt; the left panel's y axis is a decade log scale from 1e-10 to 1e0 with clean 10^n tick labels and no offset multiplier, the right panel's from 1e-3 to above 1e0. The trajectory's saddle refactor at step 6 and the terminal 3.87e-3 plateau are the two features a reader must find, and both are called out in words beside them.
rubric_items.table_form: The figure shows two spatial/temporal relationships a table cannot: a residual trajectory against Newton step with an intra-run excursion, and a per-lane read population beside the unperturbed value. Neither panel depicts tabular data.
